title: Marcos A. Aidukaitis
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young adult
Missionary to Brazil Sao Paulo South Mission
BS in Mechanical Engineering from BYU; MBA from BYU
Married Luisa Englert 1986; later sealed in the Provo Utah Temple, five children
High Councilor; Stake President, Regional Welfare Agent, Area Authority Seventy
Mission president for Brazil Brasilia Mission 2005-2008
